name: Text Anonymization Benchmark (TAB)
domain: European Court of Human Rights cases
redistribution_note: The canonical repository states that TAB is released under the MIT License. Long Gate does not vendor the corpus; preparation downloads the pinned upstream files locally and preserves upstream license/provenance.

paper.title: The Text Anonymization Benchmark (TAB): A Dedicated Corpus and Evaluation Framework for Text Anonymization

evaluation_semantics.long_gate_metric_note: Long Gate's initial adapter reports transparent literal-retention/removal metrics over annotated spans. These are not the official TAB evaluation scores.
